sentences.text:
Author: K. Lakshman
Bench: K. Lakshman
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice K. Lakshman
 Writ Petition No.19734 of 2025
Oral Order:
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Assistant Government Pleader for Home.
2. Petitioner is a resident of Malkapur Village, Sangareddy District.

At the instance of respondent Nos.4 to 6, respondent No.3 has been harassing the petitioner by calling him to the police station without following due procedure laid down under law and insisting him to settle the civil disputes between the petitioner and respondent Nos.4 to 6.

Challenging the said action of respondent No.3,
petitioner filed the present writ petition.

3. Whereas, learned Assistant Government Pleader for Home, on instructions, would submit that respondent No.3 has received a complaint from respondent No.5 alleging that petitioner sold land admeasuring Ac.0.18 guntas in Sy.No.441/E and 448/A, situated at Malkapur Village, Kondapur Mandal, Sangareddy District, and he has paid total sale consideration of Rs.1.06 lakhs.
Petitioner is not executing the registered sale deed in favour of respondent No.5.
Thus, according to respondent No.5, petitioner cheated him and also committed criminal breach of trust.
Basing on the complaint of respondent No.5, police registered a case in Crime No.119 of 2024 on 20.12.2024 for the offences punishable under Sections 406 and 420 of IPC.
The punishment prescribed for the aforesaid offences is below seven years.
Therefore, the Investigating Officer in the said crime called the petitioner for the purpose of serving notice under Section 35(3) of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (BNSS, 2023).
Except that respondent No.3 never harassed the petitioner as alleged in the writ affidavit.
4. In the light of the said submissions, notice to respondent Nos.4 to 6 is dispensed with.
This Writ Petition is disposed of directing respondent No.3 not to harass the petitioner under the guise of service of notice under Section 35(3) of BNSS, 2023.
The Investigating Officer in the said crime shall conduct the investigation strictly in accordance with the procedure laid down under law.
Miscellaneous applications, if any pending, shall stand closed.
There shall be no order as to costs.
